intro.title: Admetec Lights
intro.description: Loupes and lights are two elements that make up a single solution and should be considered in conjunction, not as separate products. Matching the best light for your loupes is a key step in the customization process.

categories.name: Wireless
categories.tagline: Meet the Butterfly EVO, Admetec's cordless headlight series, featuring two models designed for optimal efficiency.

products.name: Butterfly-S EVO
products.description: Butterflu-S™ EVO provides stronger light intensity to enable work with higher magnifications.

products.name: Butterfly EVO
products.description: Butterfly™ EVO combines effective lighting in an ultra-lightweight, easy-to-use, wireless configuration

categories.name: Wired
categories.tagline: Introducing Orchid™, Admetec’s wired headlight series, featuring three powerful models. Each Orchid™ model delivers optimal illumination according to your specific needs.

products.name: Orchid-S Headlight
products.description: Orchid-S™ Provides a higher-intensity light, ideal for surgical procedures and large magnifications.

products.name: Orchid-F Headlight
products.description: Orchid-F™ features an integrated yellow filter that prevents composite hardening. The function can be turned on and off as needed

products.name: Orchid Headlight
products.description: The original Orchid™ generates a focused, uniform, and shadow-free round beam for bright white illumination.

products.name: Orchid-E Headlight
products.description: Orchid-E™ Designed for a high-intensity, narrow light beam. Particularly well suited for large magnifications.
